## CatGo 1.4.14

CatGo 1.4.14 is the completed cross-platform reliability release for CatBot,
Campaigns, scientific workflows, large trajectories, and the integrated
terminal. It supersedes the unpublished 1.4.10–1.4.13 drafts and includes a
Windows UTF-8 correction found by the packaged-runtime release smoke test.

### Highlights

- **Installed CatBot is complete on Windows, macOS, and Linux** — Claude,
  Codex, and Gemini discovery, attachments, voice, Skills, CatGo MCP tools,
  structures, workflows, and Campaigns are exercised from packaged backends.
- **Windows Campaigns are fast and Unicode-safe** — frozen actions execute in
  the existing backend process, and every Campaign Markdown read/write uses
  UTF-8 instead of the Windows cp1252 locale.
- **Surface workflows are scientifically complete** — the clean slab is
  relaxed before adsorbate branches, while exact frozen atoms propagate through
  slab optimization, adsorbate optimization, and frequency calculations.
- **Large trajectories and terminals stay usable** — bounded frame caches
  reduce memory pressure, and terminal reflow keeps CJK text and the final
  column visible beside the scrollbar.
- **Release assets are version-bound** — desktop packages, mobile builds,
  sidecars, VSIX, HPC bundles, legal files, signatures, and mirror metadata are
  validated against the exact tag before publication.

### Fixed

#### Windows CatBot and Campaigns

- Fixed packaged Campaign actions timing out after recursively relaunching the
  PyInstaller one-file backend. Frozen dispatch now runs in-process without
  blocking asynchronous REST or MCP requests.
- Fixed Campaign creation failing on Windows with `UnicodeEncodeError` when a
  generated Markdown file contained characters such as `→`, `₂`, or CJK text.
  Campaign scaffolding, status, analysis, literature, report, and VASP sanity
  text I/O now specifies UTF-8 explicitly.
- Added a regression test that rejects Campaign scaffolding code which falls
  back to the operating-system locale codec.
- Fixed GUI-launched desktop apps failing to find user-installed Claude, Codex,
  or Gemini CLIs because Windows and macOS launchers supplied a reduced PATH.
- Fixed Windows local terminals selecting the wrong shell or losing their
  working directory across runtime transitions.

#### CatBot integration

- Preserved each user's Codex Skills and MCP configuration while registering
  CatGo desktop tools in an independent namespace.
- Added live Codex model discovery so the CatBot label follows the installed
  CLI instead of displaying a stale hard-coded model version.
- Fixed images, PDFs, text documents, and general attachments appearing in the
  composer without reaching Claude, Codex, Gemini, or backend-relay requests.
- Fixed the first microphone request racing the native voice router and getting
  stuck on an unavailable browser fallback.
- Routed structure, workflow, Campaign, and export operations through the active
  CatGo runtime connection instead of fixed localhost ports.
- Preserved structures when pop-out chat or viewer windows are closed and later
  reopened.

#### Workflows and surface science

- Added safe bulk selection and deletion for project and workflow lists, with
  durable success and failure feedback.
- Derived workflow state from task evidence so CHECK, PAUSED, FAILED,
  REMOTE_ERROR, RUNNING, and completed workflows are not mislabeled.
- Added clean-slab geometry optimization before adsorbate branches generated by
  CatBot.
- Persisted manually selected frozen atoms and slab-generated constraints into
  downstream geometry optimization and adsorbate-only frequency inputs.
- Fixed slab and geometry-optimization previews displaying different frozen
  layers for the same structure.

#### Networking, trajectories, and terminal rendering

- Prevented Materials Project, OPTIMADE, and PubChem requests from inheriting
  agent-only SOCKS proxy settings while retaining ordinary backend proxy
  support.
- Improved OPTIMADE provider recovery and error reporting.
- Synchronized typed trajectory positions with topology and bond snapshots in
  Large System Performance Mode, bounded decoded frame caches, and avoided
  retaining an unbounded bond-object graph.
- Reserved terminal columns beside the scrollbar and reflowed active full-screen
  applications when the font changes, preventing clipped CJK characters.

### Packaging and verification

- Windows, Linux, and macOS frozen backends run end-to-end CatBot smoke tests,
  including Provider discovery, all bundled core Skills, CatGo MCP tools,
  structure and pane access, workflows, and real Campaign creation.
- Compiled Agent Bridge tests cover Claude, Codex, and Gemini sessions,
  attachments, permissions, failures, and stream completion.
- VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX publication waits for exact-version Linux,
  macOS, and Windows sidecars plus SHA-256 metadata on the public mirror.
- Linux packaging selects an ABI-compatible conda C++ runtime and validates all
  collected CXXABI and GLIBCXX requirements.

### Upgrade notes

- No project, workflow database, structure-file, trajectory, or Campaign
  migration is required.
- Existing Codex Skills and MCP configuration are retained. CatGo's desktop MCP
  entry is isolated automatically.
- Workflow deletion remains disabled for genuinely executing tasks and remote
  jobs whose identity is unresolved.
- Review generated slab constraints and calculation inputs before HPC submit;
  scientific structure and submit safety gates remain enabled.
- Reattach a file before a restored-chat follow-up that must reread its bytes;
  restored history keeps attachment metadata, not the original file payload.

### Downloads

- **Windows x86-64** — `.msi` or `-setup.exe`
- **macOS Apple Silicon** — Developer-ID signed `.dmg`
- **Linux x86-64** — `.deb` or `.rpm`
- **Android** — `CatGo-v*-android-universal.apk`
- **iOS** — [TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/FdHup5Hz)
- **VS Code / Cursor / VSCodium / Theia** — `.vsix`
- **Headless/HPC** — platform sidecars and `catgo-hpc-bundle.tar.gz`
